mainContent.selectProjectDescription: Select a project from the sidebar to start coding with ChatMux. Each project contains your chat sessions and file history.

versionUpdate.title: Update Available
versionUpdate.manualUpgradeHint: Download the latest version from GitHub Releases, or run this update command.
versionUpdate.restartServer: Please restart the server to apply changes.
versionUpdate.confirmRestartWarning: The server pulls the update, rebuilds, and restarts itself — this view drops for a couple of minutes and a failed health check rolls back automatically. tmux agent sessions keep running; only an in-flight web-run turn would be interrupted.
versionUpdate.waitingRestart: Updating — pulling, building, and restarting the server. This page reloads by itself when the new version answers.
versionUpdate.updateSucceeded: Updated — the new server is answering. Reloading…
versionUpdate.updateTimedOut: The update did not come back in time — deploy.sh may have rolled back to the previous version. Check the log:
versionUpdate.releaseModeManual: Release-artifact installs update via the checksum-verified cutover in docs/SELF-HOST.md — one-click update is intentionally not offered.

clientRefresh.message: A newer server frontend is ready. Refreshing this screen does not update the server.

serverUpdate.sourceAvailable: Target: {{version}} (latest main commit). Source updates do not have a fixed release version.
serverUpdate.releaseAvailable: An exact release target is available{{version}}.

confirm.message: The server will update and restart. Active web work may disconnect.

progress.message: Updating server. Progress is retained if this screen closes or the server restarts.

success.message: Update verified. Applying the new screen.

errors.unverified: The update completed but the expected restarted server was not verified. Use the manual command below.
errors.failedRolledBack: The update failed, but the verified rollback restored the previous release.
errors.failedRollback: The update and rollback failed. Manual recovery is required.
errors.manualRequired: A compatibility issue requires a manual update or recovery.

manual.title: Manual update
manual.release: Release installs require the checksum-verified exact-target cutover in docs/SELF-HOST.md.
manual.unknown: Install mode is unknown. Consult the documentation or status for recovery guidance.
